title: Transfer of abelianity across an equivalence from a preadditive category
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a preadditive category [def-weil-preadditive-category] with finite products, meaning that for every finite family of objects a product exists, including the terminal object for the empty family. Let $\mathcal D$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. If $E:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ is an equivalence of categories (there is a functor $H:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ with natural isomorphisms $HE\cong\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$ and $EH\cong\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal D}$), then $\mathcal C$ is abelian with its given preadditive structure.
